About

# Economist specializing in industrial organization and applied microeconomics.

::: {.lead}
My research fields are industrial organization and applied microeconomics, with a focus on retail markets, pricing, competition, and regulation. I am Full Professor at dECON, Universidad de la República, and hold a PhD in Economics from Universidad de San Andrés.
:::

## Degrees

- **PhD in Economics**, Universidad de San Andrés, 2017.
- **MA in International Economics**, Universidad de la República, 2008.
- **Bachelor in Economics**, Universidad de la República, 2001.

## Academic positions

- **Full Professor**, dECON, Facultad de Ciencias Sociales, Universidad de la República, since 2024.
- **Associate Professor**, dECON, Facultad de Ciencias Sociales, Universidad de la República, 2016–2024.
- **Director of the Department of Economics**, dECON, Facultad de Ciencias Sociales, Universidad de la República, 2021–2024.
- **Research Director**, RIDGE Antitrust and Regulation Workshop, 2019–2022.

## Teaching

Graduate teaching has included regulation, institutions, microeconomics, industrial organization, and competition policy. Undergraduate teaching has included game theory, microeconomics, introduction to economics, industrial organization, and competition policy.

::: {.list-section}
## Professional activity

More than twenty years of applied experience in competition policy, economic regulation, and market analysis. Consultant for the World Bank, IDB, CAF, ECLAC, PAHO, and UNDP, alongside public-sector and private-sector advisory work.

[Full disclosure of professional work](files/lista_consultorias.pdf) · [Professional profile](professional.html)
:::

::: {.list-section .soft-section}
## Previous public-sector activity

- Ministry of Economy and Finance — IADB Project Manager, 2010–2013.
- Ministry of Economy and Finance — regulation, public health-care system, and bankruptcy reform, 2005–2009.
- Ministry of Economy and Finance — Chief Antitrust Economist, 2003–2009.
- Ministry of Economy and Finance, Dirección General de Comercio — economic analysis, 2003–2010.
- Office of Budget and Planning — regulatory impact analysis and pricing of public services, 2001–2003.
